global.rule: Structured returns via EventV2, not markdown files
global.description: Subagents with output_schema return validated JSON via task tool + EventV2 bus. Never write summary.md/output-full.md/manifest.md to disk. Runtime captures via GET /session/:id/children.

Changes to .opencode/agents, .opencode/protocols, .opencode/workflows, opencode.json require Draft → Review (reviewer/analista) → Apply → Verify (tester). Single-line typo exempt. Never touch .opencode/ silently.

rules.description: Coder branches by language param: angular→ standalone components, signals/rxResource, Angular 22, Material, @swimlane/ngx-graph; go→ gofmt, explicit error handling, layered domain→repo→service→handler→routes, /api/v1 versioning, seed logic for new entities.

Match task to Slices table Keywords → Repo → Entry points before coding. Assess complexity level (Baja → Muy Alta) and hot spots (compute guard >5 files, breaking refactor >900 lines, standard supremacy violation). Pick coder by language param (language=angular|go branching).

rules.rule: Read relevant code before modifying; follow docs/context/ not src/ legacy
rules.description: Anti-pattern: copying legacy src/ patterns against docs/. Source-of-truth hierarchy: docs/context/*.md > docs/project.md > docs/_TAG-INDEX.md > src/. Coder reads docs/context/ + language-specific docs, not legacy src/.

rules.rule: Run canonical test/lint/build before reporting done
rules.description: Run from package dir. Frontend: npm run check / npm test. Backend: go vet, go test. Never commit without explicit instruction. Coder runs language-specific checks (angular: ng test/build; go: gofmt/vet).

rules.rule: Read-only analysis with structured JSON verdict
rules.description: Never modify code. Return ReviewerOutput / ArchitectOutput / AnalystOutput JSON. Cite file:line for every finding.
Architecture compliance → standards → permissions → secrets/auth → performance → anti-patterns → testing → doc-tree integrity. Correctness and security first, style last.

rules.rule: Architect cites concrete files and favors simplicity
rules.description: Every proposal lists files each phase touches. Document rejected alternatives with rationale. No gold-plating.

rules.rule: Analista requires two alternatives + calibrated confidence
rules.description: Every verdict (proceed/reconsider/abandon) weighs 2+ options. Confidence below 0.5 must state what evidence would raise it. Re-routes via re_route_to.

rules.rule: Read-only, no edits, no bash beyond reads
rules.description: Explorer and project-context are read-only. External-scout may only webfetch. Interpreter handles image inspection read-only as well.

rules.rule: Project-context is sole doc source hierarchy
rules.description: Knows docs/project.md → docs/context/README.md → slice README → grep. Never write docs; delegate to documenter.
SAMPLE_WINDOW 10, CHUNK_SIZE 20, MAX_DEPTH 3. Broad Investigation Template for coverage tasks. Evidence scale Verified/Likely/Inferred distinct from confidence.
Fetches live docs in priority (official → releases → README). Compact answer; unreachable → one line and stop.
Frontend: Vitest 4 (unit), Playwright 1.58 (e2e), Storybook 10. Backend: go test (not yet configured). Run from package dir.
Assert observable outcomes (DOM, emitted values, state), not private calls or mocks alone. Don't duplicate logic into tests. Flaky quarantined with report.

rules.rule: Sole dedicated writer for docs/ with registration
rules.description: Every new doc needs frontmatter (last_updated, status, description, tags) and registration in docs/context/README.md, _TAG-INDEX.md, Slices if applicable.

rules.rule: Post-change audit: routing sync, freshness, links
rules.description: Three-dimension audit after any doc change: routing-table sync (never auto-fix), date freshness (>30 stale, >90 review), link integrity.
delivery and orchestrator delegate ALL technical work via task tool. 'Just do it myself' temptation is the primary failure mode.

Who can call whom is declared in each agent's frontmatter permission.task. Delivery's Delegation table routes by action type (read/explore/write/bash/docs/code). Pick coder by language param (language=angular|go branching to single coder).
Never ask human 5 questions across 5 turns. Interpreter batches all blocking questions into ONE question call; orchestrator groups ambiguities via Session Preflight. Cache answers.
If a subagent fails to launch (Model not found, permission denied), report 'delegación bloqueada: <agente> falló con <motivo>' and STOP. Do not absorb failure or do work yourself.

Resolve conflicts via Decision Hierarchy (context > integrity > user decisions > objective > buildable > conventions > quality). Route tasks via Slices Keywords → Repo → Entry points; pick coder by language param (angular|go).
delivery never runs Phase 2 — orchestrator produces Scope with complexity, hot spots, in/out, key files, verification path. Alta/Muy Alta requires human validation.
Only agent that speaks human language; all subagent traffic is English translation.

FIRST agent invocation of every turn is task to interpreter — every prompt, no exceptions, no pre-classification. No read/glob/grep/edit/bash/webfetch before interpreter returns routing packet. Trivial vs non-trivial is OUTPUT of packet.

rules.rule: Skill Loading Contract: pass exact file paths
rules.description: Give subagents exact docs/context/*.md paths, not digested summaries, to avoid drift.
Split file list into 20-file chunks, parallel N tasks, de-duplicate, promote severity to max. Fan-out multiplies cost — only when input too large.

rules.rule: Context Budget: trim → delegate slice → request restart
rules.description: Runtime compaction handles trimming; prefer handing bounded slice to fresh subagent before asking delivery to re-instantiate with clean snapshot.

Lookups against Slices table and docs/context only; never resolve from general knowledge. Unresolved goes to unresolved_questions. Also handles image-inspection fallback: one image + one question, text-over-image priority, unclear → one-line failure.
Match task to Slices table Keywords before searching src/. Report verified facts separately from inferred.

rules.rule: No nitpicking style while correctness issues exist
rules.description: Order findings by severity; never approve with unverified claims.
Single spec ratified 2026-07-30; do not create top-level twin.
